name: local-perf-v1
calibration_policy: short bracketed search yields candidate capacity only; five alternating 10s/60s pairs at fixed candidates; failed long trial brackets refinement and restarts all five pairs
w4_generator_missed_policy: nonzero missed scheduled arrivals make qualification inconclusive; no offers after cutoff
w5_lifecycle_process: one persistent runtime per candidate; normal-close and queued-disconnect session each cycle; original idle baseline
endpoint_cpu_selection: first two CPUs in initial allowed affinity; client all processes on first, peer on second
tail_backlog_envelope: ceil(per-stream rate * capacity_p99_us / 1000000), every last-quarter sample
capacity_sample_policy: every scheduled boundary through boundary + service allowance; receiver sample[2] in-window validated
limiter_assessment: local-perf-v1-limiter-assessments.json; all client and peer actors; exact workload, capacities, frozen profile; source mapping and artifact observations; absent assessment is inconclusive
